title: Supernova Explosion
definition: A supernova is a powerful and luminous stellar explosion that occurs during the last evolutionary stages of a massive star or through the triggered detonation of a white dwarf, briefly outshining entire galaxies and dispersing heavy elements into the cosmos.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims under Science and Technology (Space Physics, Cosmic phenomena, Astronomy) and connects to GS-3 Mains regarding space exploration, astrophysics advancements, and cosmic nucleosynthesis.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Supernova Explosion.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
